concept.name: Neural network
concept.definition: A parameterized composition of affine transformations and nonlinear activations trained to approximate a mapping from inputs to outputs.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Run inputs forward through layers, compute a loss, propagate gradients backward, and update weights with an optimizer over repeated batches.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: A network maps 20 features through 32 ReLU units to one sigmoid probability and updates weights using minibatch gradients.
